data.title: 中野一花 · 演艺摄影棚的聚光灯回眸
data.description: 摄影棚中央暖色聚光灯亮起，一花优雅侧身回眸。单手轻抚右耳的单侧耳坠，自信大方的笑容中透着职业女演员的耀眼光彩。
data.action: turning back, touching earring, confident look
data.promptProse: On a professional movie studio set, Nakano Ichika turns back under dramatic overhead spotlights. Wearing a sleek tan trench coat and black turtleneck, she lightly touches her dangling earring with a poised, confident expression.
data.animaCaption: Turning under the warm studio spotlights, she touches her earring with a confident radiant smile.
